entry.title: New: dsh-projection-guard
entry.summary: Guards the persisted session-projection cache: per-row JSON degradation so one misbehaving projection unit (e.g. a third-party plugin storing a Map) can never stall session titles or the whole cache again, plus a startup self-heal that backfills missing titles. Exact install spec: github:damonkoy/dsh-projection-guard. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
